mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% is inversely related to S&P 500 20-day forward returns, as elevated rates compress equity valuations by increasing the risk-free discount rate and raising borrowing costs for corporations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering recessionary expectations that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise >0.3pp in 3 months), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1% in the past month indicate broad-based demand contraction, which precedes corporate earnings deterioration and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL growth >0.5% monthly) triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, which increase equity discount rates and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during inflationary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 (2017=100) signals manufacturing sector contraction, which reduces corporate output capacity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher real GDP level (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained profit momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds its 1-year moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment decline (PAYEMS) and unemployment rise (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points in the past month indicate severe labor market distress, which precedes recession and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls and UNRATE rises >0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS falls and UNRATE rises >0.2pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive Fed rate hikes that increase equity risk premiums and generate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
